summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily ASX notifications for its $1B stock repurchase program (authorized to buy Class A and Class B common shares). The filing updates the market on ongoing repurchases, which constitute a capital return to shareholders. No specific price, premium, or close date is provided; the program is open-ended and subject to market conditions. The board has previously authorized the program; no advisors are named. The repurchase is conducted under ASX rules with routine disclosure. Watch for cadence of buybacks and potential impact on float and earnings per share.
